title: Show issue count for epics in list view
description:
Display the number of child issues next to epic entries in list output:

Current:
  a1b2c3d4 [epic] [TODO] Feature Development

Improved:
  a1b2c3d4 [epic] [TODO] Feature Development (3 issues, 1 done)

Or minimal:
  a1b2c3d4 [epic] [TODO] Feature Development (3/1)

Benefits:
- See epic scope at a glance
- Track progress without drilling down
- Identify empty epics
- Prioritize work on epics with many incomplete issues

Should count issues with part_of relationship pointing to the epic.
